summary: Carroll County peak. The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists its tower as gone, and NH Family Hikes lists Mount Shaw among mountains which once had a fire tower, so the two sources agree. No dated history of a Shaw lookout found.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No dated or sourced account of a Shaw tower's construction, design, staffing or fate was found in the sources read. FFLOS lists it as gone; NH Family Hikes files Mt. Shaw under 'Mountains which Once Had a Fire Tower' (an earlier draft said it was under 'Active Fire Towers'; that was a misreading and is corrected here), so the two sources agree. The NHDFL state history PDF returned HTTP 403 and was not read; it is the likeliest source for a dated history. Red Hill in Moultonborough is a different, state-listed tower on a different hill (NHLR), not Mount Shaw. The story is at the low end of the 120-word range. Editor should decide whether to publish or hold for more research.
